note: Holistic chest-X-ray foreign-object taxonomy. Reconciled from objcxr_eval_119 (parts), the fb reference bank (66), and supercategory organization. Nested: superclass -> concept -> parts (region masks). part_rules are per-image completeness gates for release. coco_cat_id is pinned per LEAF (part, or part-less concept) for a stable label space. v1->v2 is MOSTLY append-only on leaf ids (identity crosswalk; new leaf ids append above the persisted max) — names/descriptions/grouping may change freely. EXCEPTION: v2 RESTRUCTURED several multi-part concepts whose sub-parts cannot be segmented in practice (only the whole device is annotated). port_catheter: dropped reservoir/septum/catheter sub-parts; now FOUR whole-body leaves = {single,double} chamber × {standard, power_injectable} (port_single/port_double/port_single_pi/port_double_pi) — PI ports look distinct (radiopaque 'CT'/marker, triangular PowerPort body). dialysis_catheter, prosthetic_valve, lvad: dropped all sub-parts (and lvad's part_rule) -> each is now a single whole-device leaf (the part-less concept itself). Retired part ids (port_reservoir/port_septum/port_catheter_tube, dialysis_tube/y_split/exit, valve_ring/valve_struts, lvad_body/outflow/driveline) are not reused; a fresh re-seed drops them from an existing project's state (the loader adds/updates but does not delete). v2 also ADDS endobronchial_coils + endobronchial_valve (bronchoscopic lung-volume-reduction implants, surgical_hardware; distinct from intravascular embolization_coils and from mesh vascular_stent). v2 adds external_furniture (superimposed wheelchair/gurney/bed-rail/IV-pole, support_equipment) ecg_junction (ECG lead-block/yoke or telemetry transmitter hub, part of ecg_leads), and bra_clasp + bra_other (back hook-and-eye closure and a catch-all for strap sliders/rings, siblings of bra_underwire under breast_chestwall), and lead-tip parts pacemaker_lead_tip / icd_lead_tip / crt_lead_tip (high-contrast distal electrode/coil end, split from the thin lead body; no completeness rule so a tip without a traceable cable is allowed), and surgical_instrument_external (loose clamp/forceps/scissors overlapping the field, support_equipment; distinct from retained-in-body gossypiboma), external_clip (non-surgical clothing/gown/drape/utility clip overlapping the field, support_equipment), dental_hardware (metallic crowns/fillings/implants/dentures; native non-metal teeth stay anatomy/unlabeled) and swallowed_fb (generic ingested esophageal/GI object, counterpart of aspirated_fb), both foreign_bodies.

concepts.name: Endotracheal tube
concepts.description: Tube in the trachea for ventilation; tip should be ~3-5 cm above the carina.

parts.name: Cuff
parts.description: Inflated cuff at the distal tube.

part_rules.desc: a cuff implies the shaft is annotated

concepts.name: Tracheostomy tube
concepts.description: Airway tube via a neck stoma.

concepts.name: Nasogastric / feeding tube
concepts.description: Tube from nose/mouth into the stomach (drainage or feeding); tip should be sub-diaphragmatic.

concepts.name: Sengstaken-Blakemore tube
concepts.description: Balloon tamponade tube for variceal bleeding.

concepts.name: Gastrostomy tube
concepts.description: Feeding tube through the abdominal wall into the stomach.

concepts.name: Central venous catheter
concepts.description: Central line via IJ/subclavian; tip ~ cavoatrial junction.

concepts.name: PICC line
concepts.description: Peripherally inserted central catheter; tip in distal SVC.

concepts.name: Swan-Ganz (PA) catheter
concepts.description: Pulmonary-artery catheter; tip in a main/proximal PA.

concepts.name: Dialysis catheter
concepts.description: Large-bore (often tunneled) hemodialysis catheter. Annotated as the whole device; sub-parts (tube/Y-split/skin exit) are not separately segmented.

concepts.name: Implanted port (port-a-cath)
concepts.description: Subcutaneous reservoir with a catheter to the SVC. Annotated as the whole port body, split by chamber count (single vs double = figure-8) AND power-injectable vs standard (PI ports carry radiopaque IDs and look distinct). Sub-parts (reservoir/septum/catheter) are not separately segmented.

parts.name: Single-chamber port (standard)
parts.description: Whole body of a single-lumen / single-reservoir STANDARD (non-power-injectable) port — one circle with one central septum, smooth body, no radiopaque ID markings.

parts.name: Double-chamber port (standard)
parts.description: Whole body of a dual-lumen / double-reservoir STANDARD (non-power-injectable) port — figure-8 (two circles / two septa), no radiopaque ID markings.

parts.name: Single-chamber power-injectable port
parts.description: Whole body of a single-chamber POWER-INJECTABLE port — one reservoir PLUS radiopaque identifiers (e.g. 'CT' lettering, triangular body / 3 palpation bumps as on the Bard PowerPort, or a radiopaque code) that make it look distinct from a standard port.

parts.name: Double-chamber power-injectable port
parts.description: Whole body of a double-chamber POWER-INJECTABLE port — figure-8 (two reservoirs) PLUS radiopaque power-injectable identifiers.

concepts.name: Intra-aortic balloon pump
concepts.description: Counterpulsation balloon catheter in the descending aorta.

concepts.name: Impella
concepts.description: Transvalvular micro-axial LV assist catheter.

concepts.name: ECMO cannula
concepts.description: Large drainage/return cannulae for extracorporeal support.

concepts.name: Umbilical catheter (UAC/UVC)
concepts.description: Neonatal umbilical arterial/venous catheter.

concepts.name: Chest tube
concepts.description: Pleural drainage tube; side-hole must be intrathoracic.

concepts.name: Pigtail / small-bore drain
concepts.description: Small-bore curled drainage catheter.

concepts.name: Pacemaker
concepts.description: Permanent pacemaker: a pulse generator in a pectoral pocket with transvenous lead(s) to the heart.

parts.name: Pulse generator
parts.description: The metal can in the pectoral pocket.

parts.name: Lead
parts.description: Transvenous lead from header to chamber; tip = electrode.

parts.name: Lead tip / electrode
parts.description: High-contrast distal end of a pacing lead — the electrode/fixation tip — denser than the thin lead body.

part_rules.desc: a generator implies at least one lead

concepts.name: CRT (biventricular) device
concepts.description: Cardiac resynchronization device with RA, RV and LV/coronary-sinus leads.

parts.name: Lead tip / coil
parts.description: High-contrast distal end of any CRT lead — electrode/fixation tip or shock coil — denser than the thin lead body. Generic across the RA/RV/LV leads.

part_rules.desc: a CRT generator implies at least an RV lead

concepts.name: ICD / S-ICD
concepts.description: Implantable defibrillator: a can plus lead(s) with shock coil(s).

parts.name: Lead tip / shock coil
parts.description: High-contrast distal end of an ICD lead — the electrode tip and/or shock coil(s) (RV ± SVC) — denser than the thin lead body.

part_rules.desc: an ICD can implies a lead

concepts.name: Leadless pacemaker
concepts.description: Capsule pacemaker fixed in the RV; no leads.

concepts.name: Epicardial pacing wire
concepts.description: Temporary post-op epicardial pacing wires.

concepts.name: Implantable loop recorder
concepts.description: Small subcutaneous left-parasternal monitor.

concepts.name: CardioMEMS PA sensor
concepts.description: Wireless PA pressure sensor in a distal PA branch.

concepts.name: Spinal cord stimulator
concepts.description: Neurostimulator generator with epidural leads (often in the field on CXR).

concepts.name: Prosthetic heart valve
concepts.description: Mechanical or bioprosthetic valve (aortic/mitral/tricuspid/pulmonic). Annotated as the whole device; sub-parts (sewing ring/struts/leaflets) are not separately segmented.

concepts.name: Annuloplasty ring
concepts.description: Mitral/tricuspid repair ring.

concepts.name: TAVR
concepts.description: Transcatheter aortic valve frame.

concepts.name: MitraClip / TriClip
concepts.description: Edge-to-edge valve repair clip.

concepts.name: LAA occluder
concepts.description: Left-atrial-appendage occlusion device.

concepts.name: Septal occluder
concepts.description: ASD/VSD/PFO closure device.

concepts.name: Ventricular assist device
concepts.description: Durable assist device: pump with inflow/outflow and a driveline. Annotated as the whole device; sub-parts (pump body/outflow graft/driveline) are not separately segmented.

concepts.name: IVC filter
concepts.description: Conical caval filter.

concepts.name: Embolization coils
concepts.description: Radiopaque coil tangle(s).

concepts.name: Vascular/airway stent
concepts.description: Aortic endograft, SVC, tracheal/bronchial or esophageal stent.

concepts.name: Endobronchial coils (LVR)
concepts.description: Bronchoscopically-placed nitinol lung-volume-reduction coils in the lung parenchyma (severe emphysema). Typically MULTIPLE, peripheral, uni/bilateral. NOT intravascular embolization coils (embolization_coils), which are focal and in a vessel.

concepts.name: Endobronchial valve
concepts.description: Bronchoscopically-placed one-way endobronchial valve for lung volume reduction (severe emphysema); small radiopaque valve(s) in a lobar/segmental bronchus, typically several in one lobe.

concepts.name: Sternotomy wires
concepts.description: Midline cerclage wires after sternotomy (count matters).

concepts.name: Surgical clips
concepts.description: Clusters of metallic surgical/vascular clips.

concepts.name: Surgical staples
concepts.description: Staple line (lung resection/anastomosis).

concepts.name: Spinal hardware
concepts.description: Pedicle screws, rods, vertebroplasty cement, plates, cages in the field.

concepts.name: Shoulder/humeral hardware
concepts.description: Arthroplasty/plates at the corners of the film.

concepts.name: Surgical mesh
concepts.description: Radiopaque mesh.

concepts.name: Brachytherapy seeds
concepts.description: Small radioactive seed cluster.

concepts.name: ECG leads & electrodes
concepts.description: External ECG lead wires and snap electrodes overlying the chest.

parts.name: Lead junction / transmitter
parts.description: Connector hub where ECG electrode wires consolidate into the monitor trunk cable; or a telemetry transmitter pack.

concepts.name: Zio / Holter patch
concepts.description: Adhesive single-lead monitor patch.

concepts.name: Defib / pacing pads
concepts.description: External adhesive defibrillation/pacing pads.

concepts.name: Oxygen mask / cannula
concepts.description: O2 mask or nasal cannula tubing overlying the face/chest.

concepts.name: Ventilator circuit / hose
concepts.description: Ventilator tubing crossing the field.

concepts.name: Cervical collar
concepts.description: Rigid C-collar at the neck/upper field.

concepts.name: Halo fixator
concepts.description: Halo external fixation ring/posts.

concepts.name: Off-frame cables / monitor wires
concepts.description: Stray cables/wires crossing the image.

concepts.name: External furniture / transport
concepts.description: Non-medical external object superimposed on the field: wheelchair, gurney/stretcher frame, bed rail, IV pole, backboard.

concepts.name: External surgical instrument
concepts.description: Loose surgical instrument overlapping the field, NOT implanted or retained: clamp/hemostat/forceps/scissors, e.g. clamping an external tube or lying on the patient. A retained in-body instrument is gossypiboma instead.

concepts.name: External clip / fastener
concepts.description: External non-surgical clip/fastener overlapping the field: clothing/gown snap, drape/towel clamp, or a clip securing tubing to a gown. Not a surgical instrument (surgical_instrument_external), ECG snap (ecg_electrode), or worn jewelry.

concepts.name: Coin
concepts.description: Swallowed coin (often pediatric esophagus); uniform disc.

concepts.name: Button battery
concepts.description: Disc battery with the double-ring 'halo' sign (emergency).

concepts.name: Pellets / shot
concepts.description: Cluster of small metallic shot.

concepts.name: Bullet / ballistic fragment
concepts.description: Bullet or shrapnel fragment.

concepts.name: Magnet(s)
concepts.description: Ingested magnet(s).

concepts.name: Safety pin
concepts.description: Swallowed safety pin (pediatric).

concepts.name: Aspirated foreign body
concepts.description: Aspirated object in the airway.

concepts.name: Swallowed foreign body
concepts.description: Ingested radiopaque object in the esophagus/GI tract not covered by a specific leaf (e.g. swallowed tooth/denture). Specific ingested items have their own leaves: coin, button_battery, magnet, safety_pin.

concepts.name: Retained surgical item
concepts.description: Retained sponge/instrument (radiopaque marker).

concepts.name: Jewelry / piercing / hairpin
concepts.description: Overlying metallic personal item.

concepts.name: Dental hardware
concepts.description: Metallic dental work overlying the upper field: crowns, fillings/amalgam, bridges, dental implants, metal dentures/grills. Native (non-metallic) teeth are anatomy and not labeled; a displaced/aspirated tooth or denture is aspirated_fb / swallowed_fb.

concepts.name: Breast implant / expander
concepts.description: Implant or tissue expander overlying the chest wall.

concepts.name: Bra underwire
concepts.description: Curved underwire overlying the lower chest.

concepts.name: Bra clasp / hooks
concepts.description: Metallic hook-and-eye back closure of a bra, overlying the posterior chest/spine.

concepts.name: Bra hardware (other)
concepts.description: Catch-all for other metallic bra elements not covered by underwire or clasp: strap sliders/adjusters, rings, decorative metal.

concepts.name: Breast biopsy/nipple marker
concepts.description: Small biopsy clip or nipple marker.

concepts.name: Cochlear implant
concepts.description: Cochlear implant coil (upper field).

concepts.name: Laterality marker
concepts.description: L/R side marker placed in the image.

concepts.name: Burn-in text / annotation
concepts.description: Text/annotation burned into the image.

concepts.name: Scale / ruler
concepts.description: Measurement ruler/markers.

concepts.name: Grid / scratch / artifact
concepts.description: Grid lines, scratches, or other non-anatomic artifacts.

concepts.name: VP shunt
concepts.description: Ventriculoperitoneal shunt: reservoir + catheter crossing the chest.
